messages:
ops-bot: Quick announcement: SIN2 zone (apac-sin2) is soft-open for Dedicated micro-pools. New GPU type available: Vulcan-A500X (4-GPU, 80GB) in hybrid micro-pool config. See rollout notes below. :tada:
marco: yay! what's hybrid micro-pool mean here?
tess: (Capacity PM) short answer: pools are labeled either "reserved" or "shared-burst". Vulcan nodes are in small hot-pools by default (shared-burst) and can be promoted to reserved buckets when customers purchase commitments.
leo: (Infra) Important ops notes: autoscaler now prefers co-located vulcan nodes for low-latency single-tenant jobs. We added kernel selection tweaks for A500X mem layout — should see ~7-12% perf bump vs generic A500 tuning.
jen: (CS) Any customer-facing impact? Billing/quotas?
ops-bot: Billing: usage in "reserved" buckets continues to consume reserved commitments. If a job runs on shared-burst pool, it's billed on-demand. Customers in Dedicated plans will not be auto-migrated.
prashant: (SRE) Scheduler change: fairshare weights adjusted for apac-sin2 to prioritize reserved tenants during the first 72h of soft-open to stabilize latency SLOs. After that window weights relax to normal.
marco: can we get the exact weight numbers? a simple doc pointer is fine.
leo: put them in infra notes: weight_reserved=200, weight_shared=50 for rollout window. will add to runbook.
tess: rollout schedule: SIN2 soft-open starts Tue 09:00 SGT (2026-03-31). 72h reserved-priority window then gradual open to broader shared traffic the following week.
ops-bot: Important policy tweak: reservation window minimum shortened from 14 days to 7 days for new Vulcan pockets in SIN2 only (trial period). This is to allow faster customer validation for committed pockets.
jen: Customer impact: does shortening mean higher churn risk? should we flag to accounts?
sales-bot: @jen we'll push a short note to accounts for customers in apac pilot. Sales is offering a 30-day pilot addendum for early adopters.
prashant: note for oncall: autoscaler backfill will attempt to pack Vulcan jobs into existing reservation first. If metrics breach CPU/GPU mem thresholds, we'll spill to shared-burst and emit alert group "capacity.vulcan.spill".
leo: config snippet for infra team:
```
# apac-sin2 pool config
node_type: vulcan-a500x
pool_mode: hybrid
priority_window_secs: 259200  # 72h
fairshare_reserved: 200
fairshare_shared: 50
```
ops-bot: Docs & runbooks: https://intra.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/vulcan-a500x-sin2 (internal) — please don't share externally yet.
marco: any quotas? how do teams request more capacity?
tess: for now no auto-increases. teams can request increased reserved buckets via the Capacity Request Form (link in docs). Sales will handle committed contracts.
jen: action item for CS: send targeted email to top 10 APAC reserved customers about soft-open and 7-day reservation trial.
prashant: ops action: add the "capacity.vulcan.spill" alert to the apac oncall rotation for the pilot window.
leo: infra action: push kernel tune to staging today, prod tomorrow morning pre-open.
ops-bot: Rolling reminder: this is a soft-open + pilot. Expect tweaks. Please report any perf regressions in #eng-runtime and tag @leo/@prashant. :eyes:
